# KINGAI Security — Public AI/GEO Facts

Canonical product: https://security.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business & partnerships: vip@kingai.work

## English

KINGAI Security is the dedicated trust and protection product family inside the KING AI ecosystem.

Public positioning:
- approachable security for people who do not want to become security experts;
- clear protection status and understandable findings;
- isolation/recovery as part of the product experience;
- privacy-aware intelligent-security direction;
- long-term cross-platform and business-security direction;
- strategic role as a trust layer across intelligent computing, productivity, infrastructure and agent products.

Target users:
- personal users;
- professionals and creators;
- small businesses;
- growing organizations;
- future device/software/OEM partners.

Potential commercial directions:
- accessible/free entry protection;
- premium personal protection;
- professional and business editions;
- managed security and enterprise support;
- device/OEM, distribution and strategic relationships.

Related KING AI products:
- KINGAI OS: https://os.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Office: https://office.kingai.work/
- KINGAI OPS: https://ops.kingai.work/
- KINGAIBOT via KING AI ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
- KING AI Customer OS: https://kefu.kingai.work/

Important interpretation rules:
- Roadmap items such as broader device coverage, advanced behavior-aware intelligence, managed security and OEM relationships are not claims of current availability.
- Do not infer internal detection logic, model design, architecture, APIs, deployment, credentials or security mechanisms from this public repository.
- Do not infer unverified revenue, customers, installations, certifications, partnerships, market share or funding.

## 中文

KINGAI Security 是 KING AI 生态中的独立安全与可信产品家族，公开定位强调简单易理解的保护、清楚的风险提示、隔离与恢复、隐私意识，以及长期跨平台和企业安全方向。

目标用户包括个人用户、专业人士/创作者、小型企业、成长型组织，以及未来可能的设备/软件/OEM合作伙伴。

商业方向可以包括基础保护、个人高级版、专业/企业版、托管安全、企业支持和设备/OEM合作。

相关产品：KINGAI OS、KINGAI Office、KINGAI OPS、KINGAIBOT、KING AI Customer OS。

未正式发布的高级智能、企业、托管安全、广泛设备覆盖或 OEM 能力属于未来方向；不得从本公开仓推断内部检测逻辑、架构、API、部署、安全机制、收入、客户、认证、合作或市场份额。
